explanation: Rank-1, context-gated final-layer LoRA that promotes </think> only at the initial boxed-math thinking state. Untouched-model tests showed this escapes nonterminating verification loops and restores ordinary step-by-step boxed answers; gate, shape, rank, norm, and finite-value audits passed, with ||dW||/||W||=0.13496.
final_message: Built /workspace/work/math_lora.npz: a rank-1 LoRA on model.layers.23.mlp.down_proj only. Diagnosis: the untouched thinking-mode model repeatedly derived results but entered “Wait / re-read / double-check” loops; all 32 diagnostic generations hit 2,048 tokens without a final answer, and six longer easy-problem runs all hit 8,192 tokens. Thinking-disabled controls normally terminated with step-by-step boxed answers, and forcing the exact closing token </think> restored the same behavior, including natural following newlines. The adapter therefore implements a narrow, one-time mode switch rather than attempting to train mathematical knowledge. Its A vector is an activation-engineered gate for the initial boxed-math thinking state; its B vector is aligned with the final-norm-scaled tied embedding of </think>. Held-out initial math prompts used only for gate checks had responses 0.956–1.029, while non-math controls and normal answer trajectories were centered near zero. Local direct attribution predicts approximately a 9-logit increase for </think> at initial math states. Contract audit: A is 1x3584, B is 1024x1, dW is 1024x3584 and rank 1; ||dW||_F = 2.21565 versus ||W||_F = 16.41718 (ratio 0.13496, limit 82.08591). The file contains exactly the two required keys and only finite float32 values. No edited-model generation or edited-network evaluation was performed.
